about.subtitle: About Us
about.title: Combining Ancient Wisdom With Modern Medicine
about.quote: The soul always knows what to do to heal itself. The challenge is to silence the mind.
about.paragraph1: Maison Healing was founded with the mission of bringing comprehensive healing experiences, combining traditional Eastern medicine and modern science.
about.paragraph2: We recognize that while Western medicine and psychotherapy play important roles in disease management, the root causes of symptoms are often not thoroughly addressed.

course.subtitle: Courses
course.title: Heal Yourself With Sound
course.description: Discover courses on singing bowls and Himalayan sound healing methods. We aim to create a healing space where everyone is warmly welcomed.

basic.title: Basic Course
basic.subtitle: Applying Singing Bowls in Daily Life
basic.description: Today, singing bowls have become a positive life support tool applied in meditation, yoga, spa, or therapeutic support for physical and mental issues. To apply this method safely and effectively, we have compiled essential foundational knowledge in our Singing Bowl Application courses. The learning path from Basic to Advanced is suitable for different purposes and audiences.
basic.intro: The first step to get familiar with this method, let's start with the Basic course together.

highlights.title: Course Highlights at Maison Healing
items: Learn to approach Himalayan singing bowl sound therapy safely and effectively
Practical course content that is easy to visualize and practice
Shortened learning time, affordable participation fee for everyone
Lifetime access to review sessions and knowledge updates
10% discount on products and other activities
Friendly learning environment, close to nature

suitable.title: This course is suitable for you if
items: You want to learn and apply sound therapy methods for yourself or proactively care for your loved ones
You are looking for opportunities to change yourself, develop self-healing, and explore the journey to become a professional Sound Healer
You practice yoga, meditation, or work in therapy, healing, coaching
You have a singing bowl but don't know how to use it safely and effectively

theory.title: Theory Section
items: Learn about the history, operating principles, effects of singing bowls and the path of bowl therapy
Study the chakra system and the compatibility between chakras and sound for therapeutic applications

practice.title: Practical Application of Singing Bowls
items: Bowl striking techniques from basic to advanced with various mallets using different methods
Techniques for using bowls for self-cultivation, meditation, to help you relax and develop consciousness
Practice Scan and Chanting sessions for cleansing, balancing, and protecting energy
Pain relief therapy, support for emotional and mental health issues
Guide to applying singing bowls in daily life: Yoga, Spa, meditation, space cleansing, supporting pregnant mothers and children
Guide to setting up a complete therapy session with 1-2-3 bowls
Precautions when using bowls, guidance on energy release for health and peace on the healing journey
End-of-course practical assessment
